description: Spire Global operates a constellation of small satellites that collect radio signals and atmospheric measurements around the clock and sells the resulting aviation, weather and government data. Coverage: global, including oceans, deserts and mountains where terrestrial receivers are absent; aviation data combine space-based and terrestrial ADS-B with real-time and historical aircraft positions, flight data and flight status, plus aircraft type, airline and flight information; weather and climate data cover hundreds of atmospheric and oceanic variables from space-based sensors, with custom forecast models, sub-seasonal forecasts and a DeepVision dashboard merging satellite and ground data; government offerings add radio frequency geolocation. Spire's maritime AIS business now appears under Kpler on spire.com's maritime pages and is recorded separately. Format and access: developer APIs, ready-to-use file formats and custom historical data deliveries, with free aviation data samples and a flight tracking demo; commercial contracts under published data descriptions and order forms for the weather and aviation solutions. Licence: commercial; the downloadable terms were not opened. Caveats: prices, archive start dates and variable lists were not read. Simulation uses: flight trajectories and status for aviation network flow and disruption studies, and weather observations and forecasts as hazard and demand drivers for energy and transport models. Related records: Kpler (Spire Maritime) AIS ship tracking (data-kpler-spire-maritime-ais-ship-tracking) and the open OpenSky Network air traffic data (data-opensky-network).
